meta.title: 侧栏布局大师 · Sidebar Suite
meta.description: 一款专门针对改进 DSH 左侧栏体验的插件：三种布局一键切换、会话默认全展开、临时会话默认在退出 DSH 时删除（每天定时清理默认关，可在本页开启并设时间）、临时会话可右键保留为正式会话或立即删除、设置与反馈都在本页（全部 9 项配置都有开关，改配置文件约 3 秒自动生效、免重启），强实用性；界面沿用宿主原生配色、圆角与间距，只加属性不重构宿主结构，克制又好看。｜A plugin dedicated to a better DSH sidebar: one-click layouts, always-expanded sessions, temp sessions deleted when DSH quits by default (daily cleanup off by default and opt-in) and a right-click menu to keep or delete one temp session, in-page settings/feedback — every config key has a switch and file edits hot-reload — seriously practical; native colours, radii and spacing with zero host-DOM rewrites — restrained and good-looking.
